messages:
Maya Chen: FYI incidentbot is spamming pages to the core-sre rotation right now. Getting a bunch of dup pages from the webhook.
Samir Patel: saw that. looks like two incidentbot instances think they're leader?
Maya Chen: yep multiple pages in <5s windows, some users reporting 3 pings in a row.
IncidentBot: ALERT: notify-service webhook retry 500 -> fallback, sending page to #oncall-sre (id: 9922).
Zach H: logs show two pods processing the same webhook ID: `evt-9a3f`. lock acquire failed -> fallback path fired concurrently.
Samir Patel: can we throttle the outbound pager for the rotation while we triage?
Maya Chen: temporarily paused notify outbound in the router: `kubectl scale deployment notify-outbound --replicas=0` (paused to stop noise).
Oncall Rotation: thanks, we're getting flooded. We missed an ack on one customer alert because of the retry storm, looks like it raced with a partial suppressor state.
SRE-Infra: digging into leader-election logs. suspect redis lock TTL vs pod clock skew and a stale lock renewal bug.
Zach H: attaching snippet of the lock renewal trace: ```WARN leader-elected: lock renew took 12037ms, ttl=10000ms, renewing=false```
Samir Patel: that matches — if renew exceeds ttl both pods think lock expired and try to take leadership simultaneously.
Maya Chen: customer impact: CUST-231 reported duplicate pages and one missed escalation to their oncall engineer. They're live and annoyed.
Oncall Rotation: we coordinated with CSE to confirm no production data loss, it's purely paging noise but it delayed the right person getting paged for ~90s.
SRE-Infra: mitigation plan: 1) disable second instance leader path by cordoning the node running pod notify-2; 2) patch lock code to use atomic renew and a jitter backoff; 3) add metric for lock_renew_latency; 4) rollout hotfix.
Samir Patel: I'm cordoning node now: `kubectl cordon gke-notify-us-east-3a-node-7` -> move pods off.
IncidentBot: NOTICE: outgoing pages temporarily paused by ops.
Zach H: after cordon, duplicate pages stopped. replays show single flow from notify-1 only.
Maya Chen: hotfix PR: https://git.company/repo/notify/commit/7f9a2 - adds renew-attempt-id and server-side check. Rolling to canary (1 pod).
Samir Patel: canary looks good for 10m with no duplicate pages. promoting to full rollout.
SRE-Infra: added an emergency guard: if identical webhook id seen twice within 30s, dedupe at router level. Config: `dedupe_window_seconds: 30`
Oncall Rotation: appreciate the quick fix. we'll follow up in postmortem with clearer runbook steps for pausing outbound pages.
Maya Chen: followups: 1) add runbook step to check `lock_renew_latency` before scaling leader candidates; 2) re-evaluate ttl to include worst-case renew latency; 3) customer outreach note for CUST-231 drafted.
Zach H: draft outreach: "we observed duplicate pager notifications due to our internal leader election race; no data loss; we've deployed a fix and will follow up with a postmortem."
Samir Patel: also adding a synthetic test that forces lock renew latency > ttl to catch this in CI.
Maya Chen: thanks team. reopening monitor after full rollout and dedupe in place. I'll kick off the postmortem doc and assign action items. :raised_hands:
